summary: Backend and frontend tested end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend pytest suite: 15/15 passing (auth, dashboard summary/trend, clients, batches, plans, payments, reminder templates/logs, manual reminder queue, logout, security headers, unauthenticated 401). Frontend: login → dashboard renders with correct seed values (Total pending ₹5,000, Overdue accounts 2, Reminders today 3, 2 active practitioners), sidebar navigation across Dashboard/Clients/Batches & plans/Finances/Reminders/Settings works, Reminders page shows queued log entries after Remind is invoked. No console errors, no page errors, security headers (HSTS/CSP/X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options) all present.
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell nav-testid derivation `label.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-').replace('&-', '')` is clever but brittle — a label like 'Batches & plans' becomes 'nav-batches-plans' which surprised the review-request expectation of 'nav-batches'. Consider hardcoding testids per link for stability.

routers/finance.py `list_payments` returns clients with `whatsapp_opt_in`; UI disables Remind when false. Seed should either opt-in a couple of overdue clients or the UI should surface why the button is disabled (tooltip).
server.py catches all exceptions and returns a generic 500; ensure this doesn't shadow FastAPI's HTTPException handling (currently OK because HTTPException is handled before the generic handler).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data (2 overdue clients Aarohi Mehta and Nisha Kulkarni, ₹5,000 pending). The manual reminder API queued 3 log entries visible on the Reminders page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar testids follow pattern nav-<slug> where multi-word labels become 'nav-batches-plans'. Backend base is /api/v1. /health is internal-only (not routed by ingress); use any /api endpoint to verify security headers. Reminders logs endpoint requires client_id lookup so wait ~1s after send-manual before reading /admin/reminders/logs. WATI is intentionally mocked — reminders are queued with status 'queued'.
